title: Spurious error when remapping keyboard key bindings + key bindings broken when in Notepad++

status.label: Confirm special-key remap on current stable
status.detail: The report describes Browser Home and Start Mail mappings, a warning on save, and Outlook opening instead of the mapped media action in Notepad++; it lists PowerToys 0.88.0.

judgment.rationale: The screenshots and report identify Browser Home to Previous Track and Start Mail to Next Track, and say Continue anyway saves the mappings but Outlook still opens instead of the mapped action in Notepad++. However, the report lists PowerToys 0.88.0 and does not establish whether the warning or failure persists on current stable. It also says the PowerToys elevation state is uncertain, which matters when distinguishing a hook or target-process privilege boundary from an unsupported key path.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.88.0 and says the problem was noticed after mappings had previously been set.
The screenshots show Browser Home to Previous Track and Start Mail to Next Track, along with a warning that those keys have no assignments.
The author says continuing saves the mappings, but pressing the Email key in Notepad++ opens Outlook instead of skipping to the next track.
The issue says the PowerToys elevation state is not known and has no comments or assignees.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the warning and Start Mail failure still reproduce on current stable, and confirm whether PowerToys and Notepad++ run at different elevation levels before choosing a code path to investigate.

fix_assessment.rationale: The only reported product version is 0.88.0, and the issue does not establish whether the warning and mapping failure persist on current stable or whether the target application runs at a different elevation. These answers are needed before a current Keyboard Manager defect or specific fix can be justified.

issue_context.summary: Browser Home and Start Mail are mapped to media actions, but the Start Mail key reportedly still opens Outlook in Notepad++ after the warning is bypassed.
known_information: The screenshots show Browser Home mapped to Previous Track and Start Mail mapped to Next Track.
The save warning says Browser Home and Start Mail have no assignments; choosing Continue anyway saves the mappings.
The author says the Email key still opens Outlook rather than triggering Next Track in Notepad++.
The report does not identify whether PowerToys and Notepad++ run elevated.
inferences: The warning may relate to how these special keys are represented or assigned, but its meaning and connection to the runtime failure are not established.
A privilege mismatch between PowerToys and Notepad++ may affect whether the remap is observed by the target application.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied screenshots and mapping details make the symptom concrete, but the old version and unknown elevation state leave two important discriminators unresolved. Ask for a current-stable retest and the elevation state of both processes; do not infer that the warning itself explains the failed mapping.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body and verified there are no comments, assignees, or linked fixes.
Inspected the supplied mapping and warning screenshots.
Confirmed the report lists PowerToys 0.88.0, Amazon Music, and an uncertain PowerToys elevation state.

information_gaps.information: Whether the save warning and Start Mail to Next Track failure still reproduce on current stable, and whether PowerToys and Notepad++ run at different elevation levels
information_gaps.why_needed: A current result distinguishes a still-live defect from an old-version issue, while the two process elevation levels can determine whether Keyboard Manager can observe input in Notepad++.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current stable, re-save the same mappings and test the Email/Start Mail key in Notepad++; report whether the warning appears, whether Outlook still opens, and whether PowerToys and Notepad++ are each elevated.

actions.label: Retest the special-key mapping on current stable

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and the exact mappings: Browser Home to Previous Track and Start Mail to Next Track. You also report that choosing Continue anyway saves them, but the Email key still opens Outlook in Notepad++. Since the report is on PowerToys 0.88.0, could you confirm whether the save warning and the Start Mail failure still occur on current stable? Please also confirm whether PowerToys and Notepad++ are each running elevated; that will help distinguish a current remapping issue from a process-elevation boundary.
